notes.subject: to Shelomo (king)
notes.rationale: Huram's letter states the transport arrangement, addressing Solomon as 'yu'.

notes.subject: rafsodot
notes.rationale: רפסדות (rafts) — wordplay-name with Hiram's workman Hiram-abi? no: it appears only here and 2Chr 2:15//1Chr 22? rare term for log-rafts, kept literal.

notes.subject: nekhrot/naveam
notes.rationale: Hebrew repeats verb pairs katim/bringim plainly; no pun lost — but note on 'al yam: 'over the sea' kept as 'antap long solwara'.

translation: Na mipela bai katim ol diwai long Lebnon, olsem olgeta samting yu nidim, na mipela bai bringim ⟨את⟩ olgeta i kam long yu long ol raflong, antap long solwara, i go long Yafo; na yu bai karim ⟨את⟩ olgeta i go antap long Yerusalayim.

tokens.gloss: na mipela bai bringim ⟨את⟩ olgeta i kam
bai karim ⟨את⟩ olgeta i go antap
